title: Bound repeated review identity object-store admission work and cover loose-object scale
outcome: Measure and reduce redundant object/refs metadata admission where possible while retaining storage escape/refusal protections and unchanged observation budgets.
acceptance: Measure and reduce redundant object/refs metadata admission where possible while retaining storage escape/refusal protections and unchanged observation budgets.
